title: 第三章  大二转校生叶落
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

世纪大学—格斗系一班

今天是大二学生暑假假过来的第一天报到，虽说是报到，但和新元前一样，但学生总是最烦恼的。即便不是像旧元学生那样死读书，但现在的武考可是比以前的文考要艰难上几倍。

“哎，大家听说了吗，我们班好像要来一个转校生，好像才是炼体级”说话的是班里有着“小灵通”之称刘凌，她虽然实力不怎么样，但消息等各种各样的通知却很灵通，据说他爸是校董。

“是吗，他是什么人，能凭借区区练体级进入我们世纪学院附中的精英一中，他这后门开的也太离谱了吧！”，“哎，小刘，你知道吗？”

“哎哟，吴旻，你是不是皮痒了，敢喊我小刘，不过，我爸说好像是也是校董会里的一个人推荐的。”刘凌撇了撇嘴，“一会就知道了，这个班可不是普通人能混进来的。”

第一天开学，人总是陆陆续续地到，“咚咚咚”

这么沉重有力的高跟鞋声，除了班主任沈苍月还有谁能走得这么有气势，

“嘘！月魔女来了！”霎时，全班都陷入了一片死寂。

不一会，门口就站了一个面色清冷的冰山美女，正是沈苍月，

“刚刚那个说我来了的，给我滚到操场跑100圈！”

“啊，不是吧”，吴旻有气无力地站起来，向门口跑去，也是看到了新来的转校生，身高176左右，但这相貌实在是太普通了，周身连灵气波动都没有，妥妥的就是一个炼体级小白啊，要知道像他们这种精英班的学生，一般来说高中就已经达到了炼体九级了，而现在，精英班里的大多数学生也已经是跨过炼体级，聚灵级，达到御灵级的高手了，这样的战力已经比大多数学校里的老师都要强大了，更不用说这个班的学生大都有异能力，而且都是非富即贵。想到这，吴旻忍不住摇了摇头，眼巴巴望着月魔女，希冀能少跑几圈。

月魔女连看都不看他一眼，进了教室，“大家都到齐了吧，今天我们班来了一个新学生，大家欢迎。”班里只是响起了寥寥数声，

“叶落，还愣着干什么，快进来啊”，门口的叶落低着头慢慢走进了教室，

“来，给大家做个自我介绍”，沈苍月对叶落笑了笑，

“嗯，好的”，“大家好，我叫叶落，以后就请大家多多关照了”，

“你自己挑个位置坐吧，”叶落微微点了点头，径直走下了讲台，

“怎么那么多空位置啊，”叶落在心里嘀咕，“这边有两个空位置，有一个没书，应该没人吧”，想到这，叶落赶紧坐了下来，

周围同学的目光一直跟着叶落，精英班的学生本就不多，有的人更是长期居住在家族或者学校的修炼教室，

“他，他居然选了秦月星的旁边，奥哟，他这么敢的呀”

“他这不是死定了吗”，

Page (1/3)

Century University - Fighting Department Class 1

Today is the first day of registration for sophomore students after their summer vacation. Although it is registration, it is the same as before New Year, but students are always the most troubled.Even if you don't study hard like the old Yuan students, the current martial arts exam is several times more difficult than the previous literary exam.

"Hey, have you heard? It seems that a transfer student is coming to our class, and he seems to be at the physical training level." The person who spoke was Liu Ling, known as the "Little Smart" in the class. Although she was not very powerful, she was very knowledgeable about news and other notifications. It was said that her father was the school director.

"Really, who is he? He was able to enter the Elite No. 1 Middle School attached to our Century College with just a mere physical training. His backdoor is too outrageous!" "Hey, Xiao Liu, do you know?"

"Oh, Wu Min, are you itchy? You dare to call me Xiao Liu. However, my dad said it seemed that someone on the school board recommended him." Liu Ling curled his lips, "You will know after a while that this class is not something ordinary people can sneak into."

On the first day of school, people always arrive one after another, "dong dong dong"

With such a heavy and powerful sound of high heels, who else but class teacher Shen Cangyue could walk with such momentum?

"Hush! The Moon Witch is here!" Suddenly, the whole class fell into a dead silence.

After a while, an iceberg beauty with a cold face stood at the door, it was Shen Cangyue.

"The one who just said I'm here, get out of here and run 100 laps on the playground!"

"Ah, no." Wu Min stood up feebly and ran towards the door. He also saw the new transfer student, who was about 176cm tall, but his appearance was too ordinary. There was no aura fluctuations around him. He was just a novice at the physical training level. You must know that students in elite classes like them, generally speaking,They have reached the ninth level of physical training in high school, and now, most of the students in the elite class have also passed through the physical training level, the spirit gathering level, and the masters who have reached the spirit control level. This kind of combat power is already stronger than the teachers in most schools, not to mention that most of the students in this class have special abilities, and they are all rich or noble.Thinking of this, Wu Min couldn't help but shook his head and looked at the Moon Witch eagerly, hoping to run less laps.

The Moon Witch entered the classroom without even looking at him, "Everyone is here, there is a new student in our class today. Welcome." There were only a few voices in the class.

"Ye Luo, what are you doing standing still? Come in quickly." Ye Luo at the door lowered his head and slowly walked into the classroom.

"Come on, let me introduce myself to everyone." Shen Cangyue smiled at Ye Luo.

"Well, okay", "Hello everyone, my name is Ye Luo. Please take care of me from now on."

"You can choose a seat yourself," Ye Luo nodded slightly and walked straight off the podium.

"Why are there so many empty seats?" Ye Luo muttered in his heart, "There are two empty seats here, and one of them has no books. There must be no one there." Thinking of this, Ye Luo quickly sat down.

The eyes of the surrounding students have been following Ye Luo. There are not many students in the elite class, and some of them have lived in the training classrooms of their families or schools for a long time.

"He, he actually chose Qin Yuexing's side, oh, he is so brave."

"Isn't he dead?"
